purpose: Runtime bridge for the reduced P0 official BI collage scope. It binds authored cases to platform actions and domain UI object ids without making the oracle a permanent product truth.
policy: This file is domain-pack runtime data, not platform action vocabulary.
It names the action/object/evidence scope needed to route and judge the current reduced P0 cases.
Case-specific values and final PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED decisions still belong to the testcase/run.
Known product gaps listed here are current official UI observations for this P0 scope and must be revalidated when the UI changes.
